to: the opener (no party), or every member of the party of the opener, in any instance. A contributor outside that party gets its own copy. A cave chest goes to every run member

confirm.note: The five emits of `chest_opened`; each variant cites the lines that build it

variants.name: Solo
variants.when: The opener has no party, or the chest is a reserved encouragement chest (`chest.character`). The server deletes `items` when it is empty (node/server.js:11388-11390).

confirm.note: Encouragement items of the opener are pushed into the same `r` before `items` is deleted when empty

variants.name: Party
variants.when: The opener has a party. Each member gets the same object, with `gold` set to the share of that member. `items` stays, also when it is empty.

confirm.note: One object `r` for the whole party; `r.gold` is set to each member's share just before each emit

variants.name: Contributor
variants.when: A character that helped kill the monster (encouragement) is not a looter of this chest, and it got gold, items or shells. `items` is absent when empty.

confirm.note: `goldm` is copied from the opener's `r`, so it is not always 1

variants.name: Cave
variants.when: A cave chest (`chest.cave`). The gold and amber go to the purse of the run, not to a character.

variants.name: Gone
variants.when: No chest has this `id` (another character opened it, or it never existed).

senders.what: The `open_chest` handler, no party: to the opener.
The `open_chest` handler, party: to each member of the party.
The `open_chest` handler: no chest has the id.
`encouragement_loot`: to a contributor that is not a looter of the chest.
